name: Garry's Mod
description: The famous physics sandbox with hundreds of community gamemodes. SRCDS dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Enables console commands via Source RCON (on the game port) when set. Leave empty to disable RCON.

notes: Server config lives in garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg. Mount Counter-Strike: Source or other Source content via garrysmod/cfg/mount.cfg. Workshop addons: add +host_workshop_collection <collectionId> and -authkey <Steam Web API key> to the start command. A GSLT (app 4000) is recommended for public servers: +sv_setsteamaccount <token>. Windows hosts: set the start command override to srcds.exe -game garrysmod with the same arguments.
